name: Intercom (by Fin, a Salesforce company)
oneLiner: AI-first customer service platform: the Fin AI agent plus the Intercom helpdesk (shared inbox, tickets, help center, phone). The company renamed itself Fin in May 2026 and was acquired by Salesforce in September 2026.
bestFor: Businesses that want an AI agent to answer most routine questions across chat, email, phone and messaging, with a helpdesk for the rest.

updates.text: Intercom renamed the company Fin (announced May 12, 2026); the helpdesk keeps the Intercom name.
Salesforce completed its acquisition of Fin, formerly Intercom (September 10, 2026), after signing the deal on June 15, 2026. Fin continues to serve its customers as part of Salesforce AI Labs.

features: Fin AI agent answering customers from your help content across chat, email, phone, WhatsApp, SMS and social
Fin Voice for AI phone answering
Shared inbox and ticketing for human agents
Copilot AI assistant that drafts answers for agents
Help center (knowledge base) customers can search
Proactive and outbound messages triggered by customer behavior
Phone with supervisor tools to join live calls
Reporting on AI and team performance

pricing.text: Seats: Essential $29, Advanced $85 and Expert $132 per seat per month, billed annually (new customers currently see Essential at $19, 'New customers save 35%'). Fin AI agent: $0.99 per outcome, charged once per conversation; used with another helpdesk, a minimum monthly commitment applies (e.g. 50 outcomes). Add-ons: Copilot $29 per agent per month billed annually or $35 billed monthly; Proactive Support Plus $99 per month (500 messages); Pro from $100 per month. 14-day free trial, no credit card required; 1 Full seat minimum.

notes: Company is now Fin, owned by Salesforce (deal closed September 10, 2026; reported at about $3.6 billion, not stated in the closing release). Pricing trackers show Intercom intermittently offering Essential at $19/seat for new customers during June-October 2026; review uses the $29 list price. Lightspeed's '65% resolution' and other vendor metrics were not used. intercom.com could not be fetched; pricing confirmed via several third-party pages. November 2026: intercom.com/pricing opened. It shows Essential at $19 struck through from $29 ('New customers save 35%'); the page's toggle doesn't label which billing each price follows, and the annual basis comes from the earlier check and third-party pages. G2 shows 4.5 out of 5 for Fin by Intercom; the review count differs by page (about 3,850 to 3,950), so none is cited.
pros: AI agent, shared inbox, help center and phone in one product, so the conversation history carries over when Fin hands off to a person
Fin answers across chat, email, phone, WhatsApp, SMS and social
Published prices and a 14-day free trial with no credit card
Fin is charged per outcome, once per conversation
Rated 4.5 out of 5 on G2 (Fin by Intercom)

cons.text: Two-part bill: seats plus $0.99 per Fin outcome, so the cost rises with conversation volume
Copilot for human agents is an add-on: $29 per agent per month billed annually, $35 billed monthly
Using Fin with another helpdesk carries a minimum monthly commitment (e.g. 50 outcomes)
A general customer service platform, so restaurant-specific work such as replying to Google or Yelp reviews needs another tool
